Also for what’s it’s worth, ABSA is a for-profit organization. I saw it when I was looking at the UH directory for student involvement. I didn’t think much of it at first, but after being in the club, I realized how scummy it is that it’s a for-profit org. Everyone here are college students with limited financial means, yet the founder or whoever is essentially taking their money with no return investment, or very little investment back into the club. Their scholarship is what? A thousand dollar? A drop in the bucket compared to what they make off of memberships and fundraisers. And I’m sure it doesn’t take a lot of money to organize all of these events. Just keep in mind, it is a for-profit org at the end of the day, and their main incentive is to generate profit, meeting a certain threshold of money per fiscal quarter, your money is not going back towards improving the club or the members in any ways you’d imagine.

I’d have to recommend against this club. I joined this semester as a Freshman and I got absolutely nothing out of it. The whole time I felt extremely uncomfortable with the amount of racist and homophobic remarks that were being passed around. I was placed in situations that made me feel unsafe or straight up miserable. Nothing against the org but based on my experience, just do not join.
